facts.business: Modella Woollens Limited is a listed company that did not conduct any business operations during the year except earning other income of Rs. 688.12 thousand from fees and commission.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has accumulated losses and its net worth has been fully eroded and the Company's current liabilities exceeded its current assets as at the balance sheet date. These conditions indicate the existence of a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, the financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis based on management representation.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses and fully eroded net worth
No business operations conducted during the year
Global macroeconomic challenges including Russia-Ukraine conflict and Middle East unrest affecting supply chains
Inflationary pressure in Indian economy due to global unrest
facts.related_party_note: In absence of any business activity, the Company did not enter into any material contract/arrangements with related parties, except demat charges paid to SPS Stock Brokers Pvt. Ltd. Such transactions were in the ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis.
